games.title: 會進化的魔法杖
games.description: 魔杖依戰鬥方式長出分枝，串起穿透、反彈與分裂。

proof.claim: 100 complete three-floor legal winning traces against the documented normal local enemy policy. Not unique solutions, arbitrary-policy forced wins, or all hard-mode guarantees.

games.uiWitnessMapping: Every action maps to public controls: move/attack/skill/eat mode + direction, workshop choice, guard, interact, descend, pack item/cell/rotation, star swaps, potion use, selected memory slot, part assembly, boss borrowing and repair. Real controller first/middle/last replay is tested for each game.
games.semanticDiversity: 100 unique three-floor geometry + enemy + loadout fingerprints: independently placed room doors, ice/lava tiles, enemy spawn and type, population/health bands and starting weapon/build context all affect runtime transitions.

ai.observations: Own position, HP, terrain and ally occupancy; current player or echo only within bounded line-of-sight/nearby-footstep sensing; last observed player retained for at most three turns. No future input, proof trace, unobserved distant player or hidden player build access.
ai.difficultyScope: 100 certified challenges lock normal. Free expeditions expose easy/normal/hard: sight radius 4/6/7, easy alternate-turn pursuit and two-turn windup, normal path pursuit, hard neighbor evaluation/flanking and archer retreat with one-turn windup.
